headline: Adjusted guidance holds despite steep GAAP guidance cut
summary_short: Humana grew Q2 FY2026 revenue 26.2% y/y to $40.867 billion and GAAP diluted EPS 27.1% to $5.73, but slashed full-year GAAP EPS guidance to 'at least $6.52' from 'at least $8.36' while affirming Adjusted EPS guidance of 'at least $9.00'.
summary_long: Revenue rose 26.2% y/y to $40.867B and GAAP diluted EPS rose 27.1% to $5.73, while Adjusted EPS rose 21.4% to $7.61; all three fell sharply on a sequential basis from an outsized Q1. The Insurance segment benefit ratio was 91.2%, in line with management's 'slightly above 91 percent' guidance, and full-year benefit-ratio guidance of 92.75% (±25bp) was affirmed. Full-year GAAP EPS guidance was cut to 'at least $6.52' from 'at least $8.36' on put/call valuation adjustments, value-creation charges and impairments, while Adjusted EPS guidance of 'at least $9.00' was affirmed — the adjusted figure anticipates a y/y decline from Star Ratings headwinds. Individual Medicare Advantage membership growth guidance of approximately 25% over 2025 was also affirmed.
